general.name: Site-to-Site VPN - Tunnel Down [Lin]
general.description: Alerts when hosts across a site-to-site tunnel stop answering ping. Read-only. Bad input or a failed check also alerts. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrTargets
variables.description: Required. 1-8 far-side IPs or hostnames, space or comma separated. Use hosts that are always on (the far gateway's LAN IP).

variables.name: usrRequire
variables.description: Any: alert only when no target replies. All: alert when any target does not reply.

variables.name: usrReplyTimeoutSec
variables.description: 1-5. Seconds to wait for each reply.

variables.name: usrSource
variables.description: Optional. Interface (wg0) or local IP to ping from. Needed on a tunnel gateway whose tunnel only carries LAN-sourced traffic.
